    Quotient extraction from incoming four-ray forks #

    Coefficient functionals on primitive corners modulo Jac(A)^2 assemble surjective algebra maps onto the outward affine-D₄ star or the one-loop three-leaf star. Thus every incoming four-arrow fork gives a representation-infinite quotient.
